extraction.name: Commonsense QA
extraction.description: A question answering challenge targeting commonsense knowledge
extraction.creator: Alon Talmor, Jonathan Herzig, Nicholas Lourie, Jonathan Berant
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected using Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) workers to generate and validate commonsense questions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset is based on CONCEPT NET, a graph knowledge-base containing 32 million triplets.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data generation process involves filtering triplets from CONCEPT NET, asking crowd workers to author questions, adding distractors, and verifying question quality.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowd workers were asked to formulate three questions per subgraph, one per target concept, and add two additional distractors per question.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The generated questions were verified by a disjoint group of workers, and only questions verified by at least one worker that answered correctly were used.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to test commonsense knowledge and improve natural language understanding.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases due to reporting bias and the use of crowd workers.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of data generalization limits and quality issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training, testing, and validation of natural language understanding models.
